name: Sv.Roko
description: Family friendly track with a lot of shade

name: Seaside ride
description: Easy ride along the coast with a lot of shade

name: Supetar-Vidova Gora-Škrip loop
description: Moderate ride with some steep climbs and descents

name: Vidova Gora
description: Ride to the highest peak of the island with stunning views

name: 755 Tramuntana
description: A scenic inland loop from Sutivan passing the St. Roko catacombs, olive groves of Krtina, Vičja Luka cove, and the historic village of Ložišća with its famous Rendić bell tower.

name: 754 Maestral
description: A coastal and olive grove loop heading west from Sutivan past Likva cove's ancient Roman shipwreck site, Timunić lime kiln, and the Natura 2000 Vela Lokva pond.

name: 750 - Sunca
description: A 36.7 km loop along the sunlit coastal pathways and rolling hills near Sutivan, featuring sea views, stone vineyards, and historic chapels.

name: 751 - Medulla
description: An epic 109.2 km endurance route starting from Milna, ascending all the way up to Vidova Gora (778m), descending to Bol, and looping back through inland stone villages.

name: 752 - Cvrčka
description: A 16.8 km loop from Postira winding through pine forests and ancient olive groves where the chirping of cicadas ('cvrčak') fills the Mediterranean air.

name: 753 - Tvrđava i Lanterna
description: A short 10.4 km coastal ride starting from Supetar, passing historical coastal fortifications, the lighthouse ('lanterna'), and pristine beaches.

name: 756 - Levanat
description: Named after the gentle easterly Adriatic wind, this Sutivan route takes you through quiet gravel paths, olive groves, and dry-stone walls.

name: 757 - Sv. Josip
description: A 45 km trail linking Supetar and Mirca, leading past the solitary chapel of St. Joseph, secluded bays, and rich agricultural heritage.

name: 758 - Sv. Jere
description: A 55.2 km route exploring the rugged central and southern slopes of Brač, named after Saint Jerome and featuring sweeping sea panoramas.

name: 759 - Sv. Petar
description: A 49.2 km loop centered around the historic town of Postira, visiting coastal headlands, early Christian basilica ruins, and old stone ports.

name: 760 - Sv. Juraj
description: The ultimate Brač cycling challenge: an epic 181.2 km grand tour covering almost the entire island from Supetar across all major mountain peaks and coastal towns.

name: 761 - Sv. Jelena
description: A 29.5 km scenic route heading up towards Škrip—the oldest settlement on Brač—and named after Saint Helena, mother of Emperor Constantine.

name: 762 - Sv. Lovre
description: A 27.6 km ride through eastern Brač surrounding Lovrečina bay, home to a famous sandy beach and 5th-century early Christian church ruins.

name: 764 - Macića i Vivera
description: A 19.7 km mythical trail named after mischievous local folklore spirits ('macić' and 'vivera'), passing ancient cairns and thick woods around Dol and Postira.

name: 765 - Profunda
description: A 32.1 km inland trail diving deep into the limestone interior of Brač, featuring deep sinkholes ('foveae'), quarries, and serene oak forests.

name: 766 - Srce Brača
description: A 53.5 km route through the 'Heart of Brač', exploring the interior villages of Nerežišća, Donji Humac, and Dračevica, known for stone masonry.

name: 767 - Ružmarin
description: A 19.8 km aromatic coastal route lined with wild rosemary bushes, connecting coastal coves with gentle gravel trails.

name: 768 - Plavac Mali
description: A 44.1 km vineyard trail named after Croatia's famous red grape cultivar, navigating the steep sun-drenched terraced vineyards above Bol.

name: 769 - Česmina
description: Named after the Mediterranean holm oak ('česmina'), this trail winds through evergreen forests and shaded gravel tracks near Pučišća.

name: 770 - Pinija
description: A major 90.4 km island traverse passing under tall Aleppo pine forests along the northern coast and descending toward the east.

name: 771 - Kadulja
description: A 55.0 km route through high karst meadows blanketed with wild sage ('kadulja'), offering aromatic rides and vast sea views toward the Hvar channel.

name: 772 - Panorama Povlja
description: A 17.5 km route offering panoramic views overlooking the deep bay of Povlja, its 6th-century basilica, and the Biokovo mountain range on the mainland.

name: 773 - Vrhbrača
description: A 17.0 km ride across the eastern highlands of Brač around Selca and Novo Selo, rich with white stone quarrying history.

name: 774 - Via Brachia
description: A 36.7 km route following historic paths and ancient Roman trails that originally connected the island's settlements.

name: Bells and Olives
description: Ride to the highest peak of the island with stunning views

name: Wild West
description: Challenging ride with amazing views of the island
